entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the informant.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Kairo P.S. Case No. 28 of 2023,
registered under section 376 of the I.P.C. and under section 6 of POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Judge, Lohardaga.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there is case and counter case between the parties and in retaliation the present case has been filed.
He further submits that even section 376 I.P.C.
and relevant section of POCSO Act have been added malafidely

. 
4. Learned counsel for the State submits that section 376 of I.P.C. and POCSO Act are not compoundable.

5. Learned counsel for the informant submits that there are case and counter case between the parties and in anger the O.P. No.2 filed the present case against the petitioner as the mother of petitioner has filed Kairo P.S. Case No. 27/2023 under section 376 of I.P.C. against the father of the informant.

6. Considering that there is case and counter case between the parties and it has been disclosed in I.A. No. 4904 of 2024 that in anger the informant filed the present case against the petitioner as the mother of petitioner has filed Kairo P.S. Case No. 27/2023 under section 376 of I.P.C. against the father of the informant, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the above named petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned Court within three weeks from Majbula Ansari @ Waris Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ... ... on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180917810/
1 today and in the event of his surrender / arrest, the petitioner shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Judge, Lohardaga,
in connection with Kairo P.S. Case No. 28 of 2023, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) satyarthi- Majbula Ansari @ Waris Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ... ... on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180917810/
